title: Popo Live - Live Stream Party
short_description: Live video streaming, voice party rooms, PK battles & social community!
full_description:
Welcome to Popo Live — the premier real-time live streaming, audio party room, and social creator entertainment ecosystem!

Join thousands of talented broadcasters, entertainers, and communities across the globe. Connect, interact, and share unforgettable moments in real time with high-definition video, crystal-clear voice audio, interactive PK battles, and luxury virtual gifting!

KEY FEATURES:

★ 24/7 LIVE VIDEO BROADCASTING
Watch top streamers or go live yourself with a single tap! Showcase your talents in singing, dancing, gaming, or daily life. Interact directly with viewers via real-time bullet chats, flying comments, and live reactions.

★ MULTI-SEAT VOICE PARTY ROOMS
Host or join interactive 8-seat and 12-seat voice chat rooms. Play party games, listen to music, debate, and meet like-minded friends worldwide in a warm, welcoming social lounge.

★ 1v1 REAL-TIME PK BATTLES
Challenge fellow broadcasters to intense, timed PK battles! Support your favorite host by sending battle gifts, boosting their live score bar, and determining the champion before the countdown ends.

★ LUXURY VIRTUAL GIFTS & LUCKY SURPRISES
Express your admiration with animated 3D gifts — from sparkling roses and sports cars to private jets and luxury crowns. Send Lucky Gifts with jackpot coin rewards and dynamic screen-filling effects!

★ SQUARE SOCIAL FEED & FAN CLUBS
Share photos, life updates, and short videos on the Square community feed. Like, comment, and engage with posts. Join exclusive host Fan Clubs to unlock special badges, custom perks, and private fan chats.

★ SECURE WALLET & CREATOR ECONOMY
Enjoy fast, safe coin top-ups through official Google Play Billing and verified Authorized Coin Sellers. Streamers and agencies can track daily tasks, level up their host rank, and manage earnings transparently.

★ COMMUNITY SAFETY & 24/7 MODERATION
Your safety is our top priority. Popo Live enforces strict community guidelines, 24/7 content moderation, instant user reporting, and blocking tools to ensure a respectful, inclusive environment.

Download Popo Live today and discover your new favorite live entertainment community!
